moaSummary.value: Methylxanthine used in selected neonatal apnoea pathways — educational framing only. Materia does not invent a loading dose, maintenance regimen, or serum-level target; confirm against current SA Paediatric STG/EML and the labelled product.

Third-generation cephalosporin used in selected neonatal and paediatric infection pathways — educational framing only. Materia does not invent a mg/kg dose or meningitis regimen; confirm against current SA Paediatric STG/EML and the labelled product.

Antipseudomonal cephalosporin used in selected paediatric infection pathways — educational framing only. Materia does not invent a mg/kg dose or combination rule; confirm against current SA Paediatric STG/EML and the labelled product.

Aminoglycoside used in selected neonatal/paediatric and mycobacterial pathways — educational framing only. Nephrotoxicity and ototoxicity risk apply. Materia does not invent a mg/kg dose or level-monitoring interval; confirm against current SA Paediatric STG/EML and the labelled product.

Extended-spectrum penicillin with beta-lactamase inhibitor used in selected severe paediatric infection pathways — educational framing only. Materia does not invent a mg/kg dose or infusion schedule; confirm against current SA Paediatric STG/EML and the labelled product.

Pyrimidine-analogue antifungal used in selected cryptococcal and candidal pathways, often in combination — educational framing only. Materia does not invent a dose or therapeutic-drug-monitoring target; confirm against current SA Paediatric STG/EML and the labelled product.

8-aminoquinoline antimalarial used for selected radical-cure and gametocyte pathways — educational framing only. G6PD status matters clinically. Materia does not invent a mg/kg dose or course length; confirm against current SA Paediatric STG/EML and the labelled product.

Imidazole antifungal used in selected topical and mucosal Candida pathways — educational framing only. Materia does not invent an application schedule or oral-gel regimen; confirm against current SA Paediatric STG/EML and the labelled product.

Fluoroquinolone used in selected paediatric infection and DR-TB pathways under specialist guidance — educational framing only. Materia does not invent a mg/kg dose or arthropathy-risk rule; confirm against current SA Paediatric STG/EML and the labelled product.

Sulfone used in selected leprosy, dermatitis herpetiformis, and PCP-prophylaxis contexts — educational framing only. Haemolysis risk in G6PD deficiency applies. Materia does not invent a dose; confirm against current SA Paediatric STG/EML and the labelled product.

Second-line antimycobacterial used in selected drug-resistant TB regimens — educational framing only. Materia does not invent a mg/kg dose or hepatotoxicity-monitoring interval; confirm against current SA Paediatric STG/EML and the labelled product.

Nucleoside-analogue antiviral used in selected cytomegalovirus pathways — educational framing only. Myelosuppression risk applies. Materia does not invent a dose or induction/maintenance schedule; confirm against current SA Paediatric STG/EML and the labelled product.
